extension.name: Coding Standards Drift Control
extension.description: Generate coding-standards drift reports and remediation tasks for active Spec Kit features
extension.author: Igor Benicio de Mesquita

commands.name: speckit.coding-standards-drift-control.report
commands.description: Generate or incrementally refresh coding-standards-drift-report.md for the active feature

commands.name: speckit.coding-standards-drift-control.remediation-plan
commands.description: Record remediation plans and append Spec Kit remediation tasks from the drift report

hooks.prompt: Run Coding Standards Drift Control after implementation?
hooks.description: Generate or incrementally refresh the coding-standards drift report for the active feature
